product_overview: A real-time live auction platform where bidders can browse auctions, join live auction rooms, place escrow-backed bids, manage their wallet and profile, and handle KYC verification. Sellers can create and manage auctions, while admins oversee users, sellers, auctions, subscriptions, reports, and platform configuration.
core_goals: Browse and inspect available auctions and auction details
Place real-time bids on active auctions using a wallet-backed escrow flow
Register, log in, reset passwords, and complete account setup
Submit and manage KYC verification to unlock bidding and selling actions
Manage bidder profile, wallet, payments, notifications, and subscriptions
Create, edit, and manage seller auctions and related category requests
Administer platform users, sellers, auctions, subscriptions, reports, and configuration

features.name: User Authentication and Account Setup
features.description: Users can register, log in, recover access, verify email, and complete their initial profile setup.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Enter registration details -> Submit registration form -> See email verification prompt -> Navigate to /email-verify -> Complete email verification -> Navigate to /complete-profile -> Fill in profile details -> Submit profile setup -> See account ready state
Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit login form -> See home dashboard
Navigate to /reset/password -> Enter account email -> Request a password reset -> Navigate to /reset/password/change -> Set a new password -> Confirm the password change -> Return to login page
Navigate to /register -> Enter registration details -> Submit registration form -> See a prompt to verify email before continuing

features.name: Browse Auctions
features.description: Authenticated users can view the auction catalog and open an auction to inspect its details, current status, and bids.
user_flows: Navigate to /auctions -> View the list of available auctions -> Open an auction -> See auction details, status, and current bids

features.name: Bidding on Auctions
features.description: Authenticated bidders can open an active auction and place a bid from their available wallet balance.
user_flows: Navigate to /auctions -> Open an active auction -> Enter a bid amount -> Submit the bid -> See bid confirmation
Navigate to /auctions -> Open an active auction -> Review current bid information -> Enter a lower-than-required bid amount -> Submit the bid -> See validation feedback
Navigate to /auctions -> Open an active auction -> Review the auction and bid history -> Place a qualifying bid -> See the updated leading bid state

features.name: User Profile, Wallet, Payments, Notifications, and Subscription Management
features.description: Users can review and update their profile, inspect wallet balance, view payment history, check notifications, and manage subscription access.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> View personal information -> Update profile details -> Save changes -> See the updated profile
Navigate to /profile/wallet -> View wallet balance and available funds
Navigate to /profile/payments -> View payment history
Navigate to /profile/notifications -> Review notifications
Navigate to /profile/subscription -> View current subscription status -> Manage subscription settings

features.name: Seller Auction Management
features.description: Sellers can access seller tools, review performance, create auctions, and edit existing auction listings.
user_flows: Navigate to /seller/dashboard -> View auction metrics -> Open auction creation -> Fill in auction details -> Submit the new auction -> See the created auction listed
Navigate to /seller/auctions -> View the seller's auction list -> Open an existing auction -> Review details -> Edit the auction -> Save changes -> See the updated auction
Navigate to /seller/auction/create -> Fill in auction details -> Submit the new auction -> See the auction created successfully
Navigate to /seller/auction/[id]/edit -> Update auction details -> Save changes -> See the revised auction information

features.name: Seller Auction Categories and Requests
features.description: Sellers can browse available auction categories and request new categories when needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /seller/auction/categories -> View available auction categories
Navigate to /seller/auction/categories/request -> Enter a category request -> Submit the request -> See the request recorded
Navigate to /seller/auction/categories/my-requests -> View previously submitted category requests

features.name: Seller KYC Verification
features.description: Sellers can submit identity and address documents for verification before they are allowed to fully participate in marketplace actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /seller/kyc -> Fill in verification details -> Upload required documents -> Submit verification -> See KYC status as pending
Navigate to /seller/kyc -> Review current verification details -> Update submitted information -> Resubmit verification -> See the new submission state

features.name: Seller Payments
features.description: Sellers can access payment-related information and manage seller-side payout or payment records.
user_flows: Navigate to /seller/payments -> View seller payment information

features.name: Admin Management and Platform Operations
features.description: Admins can monitor the platform, manage users, sellers, auctions, subscriptions, reports, and configuration.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> View platform metrics -> Open user management -> Search or filter users -> Review a user record -> Navigate to the user's detail page
Navigate to /admin/users -> View the user list -> Search or filter users -> Open a user detail page -> Review account information
Navigate to /admin/sellers -> View seller accounts -> Search or filter sellers -> Open a seller detail page -> Review seller information
Navigate to /admin/auctions -> View all auctions -> Search or filter auctions -> Open an auction detail page -> Review auction information
Navigate to /admin/auctions/categories -> View category management options
Navigate to /admin/auctions/requests -> View category requests -> Review pending requests
Navigate to /admin/subscriptions -> View subscription plans -> Open subscription creation -> Create a plan -> See the new plan listed
Navigate to /admin/subscriptions/features -> View subscription features -> Manage feature assignments
Navigate to /admin/subscriptions/users -> View subscribed users -> Manage user subscriptions
Navigate to /admin/reports -> View reports and analytics
Navigate to /admin/config -> View and adjust platform configuration
